name: La salle de préparation
camera: inside the scrub room, facing the porthole doors to the operating theatre

setting.walls: soft surgical-green tiles with stainless-steel trim
setting.landmark: a row of three deep steel scrub sinks with long tap levers, and round porthole double doors to the theatre
setting.light: clean cool daylight from a frosted window
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: A curious bee, a little PEEKER ("pee-KEWR"), peeks at the tiny red dot of a STING on a boy's arm while the nurse holds an ice cube.
SHE ("shee-rewr-ZHEE"), a girl in a paper cap, does SURGERY on her teddy's ear with a toy kit, steady as a pro.
A hen manager runs the hospital laundry OPERATION ("ehk-splwah-tah-SYOHN") with a clipboard, sheets flapping.
A brave puppy gets his INJECTION ("an-zhehk-SYOHN"), the nurse holding a capped syringe prop, and wins a squeaky bone.
The SURGEON ("shee-rewr-ZHYAN") in a green cap scrubs her hands at the sink, humming two whole songs.
DAMAGE! one DAY ("day") a GOAT ("GAH") wandered in and chewed the mop, leaving a puddle and torn paper towels.
A calm cat with a white MOUSTACHE ("day-tah-shuh-MAHN") watches the goat chaos with DETACHMENT, washing a paw.
The OPERATOR ("oh-pay-rah-TUHR"), a technician in a TOUR guide's cap, swings the big round theatre lamp into place.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: La salle de préparation in the B19_hopital building, ground floor (scrub room). Camera: inside the scrub room, facing the porthole doors to the operating theatre.
Setting: soft surgical-green tiles with stainless-steel trim; floor: smooth grey-green vinyl. Landmark: a row of three deep steel scrub sinks with long tap levers, and round porthole double doors to the theatre. Light: clean cool daylight from a frosted window. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the open porthole door and terrazzo floor in the near left foreground (the way back out).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, middle distance: A curious bee, a little PEEKER, peeks at the tiny red dot of a STING on a boy's arm while the nurse holds an ice cube.
- left, foreground: SHE, a girl in a paper cap, does SURGERY on her teddy's ear with a toy kit, steady as a pro.
- centre-left, middle distance: A hen manager runs the hospital laundry OPERATION with a clipboard, sheets flapping.
- centre, foreground: A brave puppy gets his INJECTION, the nurse holding a capped syringe prop, and wins a squeaky bone.
- centre-right, middle distance: The SURGEON in a green cap scrubs her hands at the sink, humming two whole songs.
- right, foreground: DAMAGE! one DAY a GOAT wandered in and chewed the mop, leaving a puddle and torn paper towels.
- far right, middle distance: A calm cat with a white MOUSTACHE watches the goat chaos with DETACHMENT, washing a paw.
- far right, foreground: The OPERATOR, a technician in a TOUR guide's cap, swings the big round theatre lamp into place.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
